lines.english: "Hm, is that so… I thought it was strange that I couldn't find your answer sheet, Kitahara."
"I'm sorry. I had already lost consciousness by that time. When I came to, I was already lying down on a bed in the hospital."
"No, you don't need to apologize. It's actually quite unfortunate. I'll let you do a supplementary exam, but in that case, no matter how good your score is, giving you an A is a bit…"
"No, it's more than enough that you give me one more chance. So when will I be taking it?"
"Let's see, I guess spring break is coming soon, so how about next Wednesday?"
"Thank you very much. I'm truly grateful for this."
"No worries, and please take care of yourself. It's still very cold right now."
"Haah…"
"How was it?"
"There was good and bad… I'll get my credit, but it won't be an A."
Now that the long period of final exams is over, the students immediately spring into high spirits in welcoming of the still chilly mid-February.
Only this time, my real battle begins after the final exams are over.
"Well, how have your grades been up until now?"
"Three wins, two draws and two losses. Those two courses couldn't be saved…"
I walked to all of my professors' offices with the medical certification I got last week trying to ask for a supplementary exam. It was a short and difficult trip.
"Even though you always got straight A's up until now. I guess things just didn't work out for you this time."
"Well, it's not like my grades really matter. I already have enough credits to graduate."
"…Is that so?"
"What I'm looking for isn't credit, it's knowledge, and I already got that long before I took the exams."
"Then why are you trying to get supplementary exams?"
"Isn't it natural to want to take exams? I'd want to see just how much my efforts amount to in numbers."
"…You… I really have to raise my hat to you when it comes to studying."
"…Shut up."
Takeya's attitude is implying that my private life is about as exciting as his right now.
"Well then… it's finally spring break, huh?"
"My spring break starts a little bit later."
All of Houjou University's courses for this year will be finished by the end of the week. And the entrance exams for the new students will start next week.
"Hey, Haruki. Do you wanna go skiing during the holidays? Snowboarding would be nice too."
"Why are you suddenly bringing this up? Did you already plan this with the nurses you were hanging out with earlier?"
"Ah, yes, the nurses… their irregular and hectic schedules cause them to build up a lot of stress, making their carnal desires insatiable!"
"You sound as if you're speaking from experience…"
"…Yeah, well, putting such magnificent experiences aside, would you be up for an invitation like that?"
"No, I…"
"And I figured you'd say that, so I'm obviously not inviting you to participate in something like that. I just thought the four of us could rent a car and go together."
"…The four of us?"
"You're just playing dumb on purpose now, right? I mean Io, you, me, and…"
"You didn't word that very well. Of course I'd be doing it on purpose if I were playing dumb."
"Setsuna-chan will be coming as well."
Even though I tried so hard to evade the subject… this guy just won't take the hint.
"Well, relaxing in a hot spring with a pretty girl that has some unusually old-fashioned tastes doesn't sound all bad to me."
"No, that's…"
She's likely not going to agree with this. Nor am I going to participate, either.
It's a sacred place for us, after all.
"…Hey Haruki. Don't you think it's about time?"
"…What do you mean?"
"You only lost your way a little. I'm sure she would understand."
"Like I said, what do you mean…?"
"You just had a bit of an affair, right? Nothing else has happened since, correct?"
"She came to see you, didn't she? But that other person didn't, right? As I thought…"
"…Your attempts at advising me have been quite arbitrary since a while ago."
"I'm just providing you with my opinion based on common sense. I'd be fine with you berating me on how it's not like me to act like this."
"Takeya…"
"There's not a single girl who's as good as Setsuna-chan, and there's not a single girl who's as incomprehensible as Senou."
What Takeya just said was utterly perfect and correct.
But if we could decide on something simply based on what's right and what's wrong, then we wouldn't have to worry about anything anymore.
"Haruki, you have to give up on that person. Have you not learned your lesson even after being treated so cruelly by her?"
…Whenever I lectured him about women before, he never paid attention to me.
"She's been like that since high school. She looks great and her acting is amazing, right? So a guy from the Theater Club…"
"Ended up… becoming attracted to her?"
"He got a taste of love from her while on stage, but he couldn't distinguish between an act and reality, and ended up falling for her."
"Ahh…"
So it was someone like me.
"But after she got off the stage, Senou was like a demon. She laughed at the guy's misunderstanding without giving it a second thought… That's how good her acting is."
"…Ahh."
As I thought… It's someone who experienced the same thing I did.
"Thanks to that incident, there weren't any male members in the club after that. She ended up having to perform all by herself come her third year."
"The Demon of Mt. Uzuki…"
"…Well, since Senou is the only actress, the quality is even higher."
"You know a lot of details, Takeya."
"I was one of the victims. When I was in second year, I joined the Theater Club to go after her. …I was kicked out after a week."
"…Glad you failed miserably, then."
"I've never met anyone as ruthless as her before or since… It felt so awkward being placed in the same class as her during my third year."
"You reap what you sow, I'd say."
Right, we all reap what we sow. No matter who we may be.
"But she never cared about it one bit. …That's the type of person she is."
"I see."
"To that person, a man is pretty much like a sign. Just like the man you see on the sign for the men's washroom."
Even though her heart is completely cold, she enacted the role of a woman who was my friend to perfection.
What does it take for a genius like that to be born into the world…?
"That's why Haruki… I won't speak ill of you. But that woman is just…"
"I know, I understand. I have to think this through and make a proper decision…"
"Don't speak with her again, alright? Her acting is just so great that I'm sure you'll just get tricked and deceived again."
"Like I said, I get it already."
I really understand that. …I understand that it's the one thing I still can't really accept.
I absolutely have to meet with her one more time.
I have to listen to what she has to say upfront, and there are words that I absolutely must tell her directly no matter what.
It doesn't matter if it'll end with me saying goodbye, resenting her, or weeping in her embrace, and…
I don't care if she'll laugh at me, make a fool out of me or tease me…
I have to make all my current feelings clear to her and decide on how to settle things between us.
"I'm still worried about you despite reminding you about this so many times… After all, you're weak to women who happen to disappear from your life without leaving a clue where to find them."
This guy really is an annoying best friend.
"Alright, let's take a short break. We'll continue at 4 o'clock～"
"Haah～"
"You've finally done it, Yoshida!"
"Damn it… She really drew me into her pace."
"Once the princess gets in the zone, everyone just becomes like that."
"Really, she really becomes a totally different person when the performance begins. She was absolutely captivating."
"I don't mind you feeling that way while you're on stage, but make sure to shift gears once rehearsal is over, got it?"
"That's exactly what I had in mind…"
"I'm sure you know by now how all the guys who misunderstood the princess' stage act and tried to get involved with her privately ended up, right?"
"Well, where is the princess now? It looked as if her body couldn't keep up with her acting near the end…"
"…Probably throwing up in a toilet somewhere."
"…Will she be alright?"
"Well, it's just the usual. She never cares about her health once practice starts."
"She still needs to change the script, right? Does she even sleep?"
"When it's a month away from the actual play, you'll never see the princess sleep. It's been like this for the past three years."
"…What a monster."
"…But it also means that you probably won't see the princess awake for the month after the performance."
"Well, even though it's always like this, I was more or less prepared for everything."
"Like what?"
"Hey, Tanaka, Ide. Stay back with Yoshida for the day."
"Will that really be okay? I've already read your instructions properly once, President, but…"
"Ah, I don't mind. Even though I can only remember the script up to the second act."
"That's fine. Today I just want everyone to get to know each other a bit."
"…What do you mean?"
"These are the backup actresses for the two heroines. Don't tell the princess, alright?"
"…I thought you two were in this together through thick and thin?"
"It's true that Watos only exists because of the princess, but I have no intention of letting it fall with her."
"Third act, fourth scene, inside Kazuki's room. Kazuki leans against the wall and looks out the window."
"The doorbell rings. But Kazuki doesn't react. The door opens after it rings two to three times."
"Yukine enters the room. But Kazuki still doesn't react to anything."
"'Kazuki-kun.' Kazuki finally turns toward her. But he immediately turns his head away and looks out the window again."
"'Let's go find Haruna…' Kazuki still doesn't give a response."
"'We might not have another chance to see each other anymore, you know? Are you really okay with that…?'"
"This isn't right."
"The scene and dialogue doesn't have any problems… but it feels as if… something's off."
"What's the conflict Yukine's facing? Why didn't she hesitate when she told Kazuki about Haruna? Why is she trying to give Kazuki a push?"
"Is it because she forgave Kazuki for his betrayal? But if that's the case, it doesn't connect with her attitude three years afterward. Why is she doing this?"
"Can her true goal be for the three of them to be together again? But she couldn't stand being Haruna's substitute. …That's too contradicting."
"Does she love Kazuki, or does she love herself…? Is she kind hearted or simply weak-willed… or does she just not care about anyone else's feelings…?"
"Ugh!"
"I really can't understand that hypocrite anymore."
"Why do you have to get so obsessed over a mere guy…?"
"It seems you're quite into it…"
"…Yo, Kazuki. I mean, Haruki."
I was convinced that she'd be surprised to see me, but my prediction ended up being wrong almost immediately.
…That's quite shocking.
"You're working quite hard despite it being so late. Aren't you worried about missing the last train?"
After my supplementary exams, I searched across the club buildings one by one before finally I found the small sign that read "Watos Troupe."
I actually hesitated for almost twenty minutes as I stood in front of the room that still had its lights on, wondering exactly what I would say if Chiaki were to be inside.
"I'm obviously not heading home at this hour. This is like my own private room in the first place."
"Is that so?"
Should I apologize for being so violent to her before, or should I continue acting as I did before and harshly condemn her for deceiving me all this time…?
"No one ever dares to come in when I'm cooped up in here. After all, no one really stays very long here if they end up pissing me off."
"You…"

In the end, I decided that I needed to compose myself in order to initiate a calm, civil conversation with her. But the moment I collect my resolve and reach for the doorknob, a foldable chair of all things is suddenly sent my way…
"Well, what's wrong, Haruki? Visiting a soldier on the front, by any chance?"
In the end, Chiaki hasn't changed much after not seeing her for a few days.
She's brazenly facing me without any semblance of guilt or embarrassment, much like the day she revealed her true self as the actress Senouchi Akira.
And I still don't have the ability to tell if this is merely an act or if this is her real self.
"I'm sorry for what I did back then. I, um, lost my cool back then… Did it hurt?"
That's why I have to take the initiative and apologize for what I did previously in order to have a proper conversation with her.
I have to face her seriously in order to draw out Chiaki's true feelings, no matter how much she'll try and mess with me.
"…Will this be a long talk?"
"That… will be up to you, Chiaki."
After staring into my eyes for a while, she let out a light sigh and relaxed her body.
"In that case, can I pick a more comfortable position? I've been practicing for the whole day today again, so I'm very tired."
"Ah, of course."
Did she finally realize that I'm serious? She still has a faint smile on her face, but she faces me directly.
And then…
"In that case, Haruki, sit over here."
"No, I can just stand…"
"But… didn't I say I wanted to be in a comfortable position?"
"Huh?"
Why did it turn out like this…?
"Mmmm～ it's been a while since I've felt this sensation. It feels great～! And I can feel your scent, Haruki."
The moment I let my guard down in the slightest, Chiaki didn't miss her chance…
She's gradually becoming more relaxed and more like how she used to act around me while she was in my room as she rests on my lap.
"I was juust getting irritated over being stuck in a rut～ But just when I needed it, you gallantly came rushing to my aid! You're the best, Haruki! I love you～!"
"Shut up…"
She's already fooling around before we can even begin a proper conversation. Is this how she's supposed to act around a man she cast aside like an old glove?
What on earth are you thinking… no, could you at least bother to think things through?
"There's really no need to act so cold toward me… I'd imagine we're pretty close, what with having been in each other's arms many times already?"
Yeah, and I wonder who it was that ended up ruining this supposed close relationship of ours?
"After not seeing your face and touching your body for so long, Haruki, I can feel a carnal desire slowly taking hold of me…"
"Like I care."
"Ahh, I'm hungry, I'm sleepy… I want to be held～"
"That's enough."
"Ow!? That hurt～! Jeez, what are you doing to an actress's face～?"
She has tears in her eyes when she looks up at me. She puts her hand on her forehead. …The expression she has now is not the one an actress should have.
"It won't leave a mark. More importantly, do you really have any intention of listening to me?"
"I mean, come on～ I haven't done that with you for three days now."
"At least eat and sleep properly. And to think you usually indulge in plenty of both back at the lab."
"That's my hibernation period～"
Did she intentionally gloss over my concern? Or is she simply reenacting "Izumi Chiaki" to utter perfection…?
"…I do have some chocolate in my bag."
"At least wait until I take it out. You look silly when you open your mouth like that."
Right now, she's the person I was familiar with one month ago: lazy and slightly high-spirited, someone who goes between a friend and a lover.
"Nn, nnn～ chu, hmm～"
"…Does it taste good?"
"It's sweet♪!"
"…Of course it is."
After all, it's the chocolate given to me by the hall staff at Goodies as a token of their gratitude.
"Haruki～ another one, another one～!"
"Stop acting like a baby bird. …I can't tell you apart from the real thing."
I'm sure she doesn't realize this. …It's February 14th today.
"Ahm, nn… nn～ ha, mn… mm… mn… fufufu…"
"Stop licking my fingertips."
Thanking and apologizing to the people who gave me this deep down, I toss the melted piece of chocolate stained with Chiaki's saliva in my mouth.
It's just like she said, the sweetness started from my throat and spread throughout my entire body.
"Give me more～"
"Show some restraint, at least."
"Nn～ ahm, mm… huu… ahh that was great～"
"If you don't take anything sweet, your brain won't function properly. How can you write a script when you don't get enough nutrition?"
"I guess you're right… No matter how I try, I just can't grasp a certain character. I can't progress past that part."
"That's why you just have to sleep properly, take it easy, and eat properly when that happens…"
"Hey, Haruki. What kind of woman do you think Ogiso Setsuna is?"
This is the result of me relenting even only slightly to her…
Her mind, which seems to have no understanding of the concept of delicacy, spurs her to be utterly inconsiderate of anyone else's emotions and circumstances.
"Do you understand her, Haruki? Do you understand everything about that complicated personality of hers?"
"If I could truly understand her, I wouldn't have had any kind of relationship with you."
"Ahaha… that's true."
Then why did you ask me that…?

"She's the bright, kind, and gorgeous idol of our high school. She's very reserved, very family-oriented, and a devoted girl who's kept to the shadows. And she's also a stubborn, troublesome woman who keeps putting up a front and keeps all her woes to herself."
"You…"
And to think you already know her so well…
"When and how she would act is something I still can't predict. She has a very calculating side, as well as a self-destructive side… Ah～ this is so puzzling～"
Even so, she's unsatisfied and wants to dig deeper into the depths of Setsuna's heart, which I'm sure Setsuna herself doesn't know very well.
"She's really a vexing girl. Though it's not every day I get to play a role like this."
Did she peer so deeply into me as well?
Were those calculating eyes of hers pondering the true meaning behind my moans even as I made her gasp in pleasure within my embrace?
"Hey, Haruki."
"Eh…"
"I'll become the real Ogiso Setsuna. I'll deliver her true feelings to you, alright?"
I felt a chill.
A helplessly disconsolate feeling rises from within me for the woman who's lying on my lap with her eyes shut blissfully, indulging in me spoiling her without reservation.
Takeya once commented on her being "an alien," and I'm slowly starting to see the truth in his words.
"Chiaki…"
"Don't say things like that without thinking them through…"
"I thought about her really hard, you know～ My head was so full of her, in fact, that I felt like it was about to burst."
"That's not what I meant. …Well, I suppose you're probably just pretending, though, right?"
"Hmm～"
"Even though you can read others' feelings so easily, why aren't you a little more considerate about their feelings…?"
"Do you not feel hurt or sad even in the slightest knowing that someone else is feeling hurt or sad? Why did you end up being someone like this…?"
"There's no particular reason behind it. I was born this way, you know?"
"You're scary. …You seem so hollow."
"Ah, is that so."
"I'd say you're even harder to understand than Setsuna. What in the world do you even want to do?"
"I wonder about that."
Even though I've already said this much, Chiaki is still lying on my lap with a composed expression.
"You paid the ultimate price and ended up making others suffer for it. …All for nothing more than a play."
"Don't call it 'nothing more than a play'…"
"But you think of me as 'nothing more than Haruki.'"
"You're the only man I'll ever see this way, Haruki."
"As nothing but a labrat, that is. I can only imagine how you've been trembling in excitement with a scalpel in your hand for the past three years."
"Think of it what you will. There's no law prohibiting me from developing feelings for a labrat."
"As far as being human goes, you're just the worst."
"Good thing I'm not human, then. I'm an actress～"
"I knew you'd say that… If you don't change, what would you do if one day, you couldn't act anymore? How are you going to live?"
"I never thought about it, nor did I bother to try. It's not like I need to think about it either. Don't underestimate my ability, alright?"
"Even so, I… even if I don't have any talent, as a normal human, I'm still worried about you, someone who's not a normal human."
There's something about Chiaki, who single-mindedly continues acting…
It's a different feeling altogether from anything I've ever felt for Setsuna or Kazusa.
There's fear, anger, unease… and a sense of pity I'm feeling willingly.
"…I'll need to write down what you just said. I think I'll use it for one of Kazuki's lines."
"Chiaki…"
Even knowing full well that my words may never reach her, there's no way I could stop my incessantly meddlesome self at this point.
"This isn't a path where everyone can be successful. Only a handful of people are successful going down this path."
"I'll just have to become someone who's among that handful then."
"Success doesn't guarantee that everything will go smoothly for you. What's the harm in being both an actress and a human?"
"I hate having a backup plan as a human. We'll talk about failing when I actually fail."
"I don't want to see you fail."
"…How do you know you'll see me fail? Are you trying to predict my future many years from now, Haruki?"
"I'd just hate to see it… But seeing the way you are now, I can't help myself from thinking that way."
"…Is that so."
"If you happened to take a wrong turn… if everything you've been doing so far stopped working and you were forced to find a new path…"
"Like I said, I…"
"Who would be there to guide you down that new path? Who'd be there to help you take that first step?"
That made even Chiaki quite dumbfounded.
She's been enjoying being on the receiving end of my meddling so far, but now she seems just as bewildered as I am about how far I'm willing to go this time.
I guess I really am an idiot.
"Haruki, you're an extremely pessimistic guy, huh?"
"Well, I have had some things happening recently that would make anyone pessimistic."
"You got scratched by a woman who you thought you'd taken in as something like a pet cat, you mean."
"Even so, I'm still worried about the cat who scratched me… because I cherish her deeply."
"…Meow～"
"Stop it… you idiot."
In any case, Chiaki's response is very typical of herーcompletely incomprehensible.
She buries her face into my lap, brushes her cheeks against me, and sticks out her tongue and licks me.
"Mew, mew… I'm so happy, I love you. I'm such a fortunate cat to be loved by her master like this."
After pretending to be a baby bird, she's now pretending to be a kitten.
Is she incapable of expressing how she truly thinks without acting as something other than herself, whether it be another human or animal…?
"Stop messing with me, you idiot. Even though you turned me into that mess. But… thank you for saving me."
If that's the case, it seems that I'm forced to talk with a feline.
I'll have to express my resentment, lingering affection, and gratitude to her… all while under the belief that none of it will reach her.
"You said something that makes me happy, Haruki… I'm feeling lustful again, meow～"
"Cats don't understand human speech."
Who am I kidding. She was never the type that would obediently follow the rules I set.
"Hey, Haruki… why don't we mate? Why don't we lustfully mate with each other like animals?"
"Cats don't seduce humans, idiot."
"Just the tip will do, then. Just putting a little in should be fine…"
"That's supposed to be the man's line."
"I'm just trying to be true to the instincts of a female cat, that's all…"
No matter how serious the other person is, she'll just give an insincere reaction in return.
"My appetite has been replaced by an immense lust recently. I get so engrossed in writing the script that I find myself doing it before I know it. …Furiously masturbating, that is…"
"I don't see how that's any of my business…"
"Wanna see some more right now, then? Wanna see me masturbate?"
"That's meaningless… I won't feel aroused by you anymore."
"My, my～ did I leave some kind of trauma?"
"Why can't you ever take things more seriously…? I came here because I wanted to have a serious conversation with you."
"Because…"
"If it's like this, no matter how long it'll be, I won't forgive you!"
"No matter how much time passes, I don't think I can let go of you…"
"…Meow… As I thought, I'm seriously feeling lustful now."
"Like I said, stop joking around…"
Chiaki continues to make fun of me, leaving me at my wits' end.
She's clinging onto my lap and panting, her body shaking wildly, and before I knew it, she dozed off… playing the role of a desperately attached kitten to perfection.
Well, I'm now stuck in a situation where I can't escape from her little cat charade…
In the end, I could only begrudgingly surrender myself to the role of being Chiaki's pillow, stroking the stray cat's head as she lets out breaths while sleeping.
Really, what am I even doing? What am I doing with the person who's betrayed me in a way no one else has ever done before…?
Why am I still harboring such feelings for her again even after what she's done to me…?
